upload.route: /api/private-media?conversation_id=<valid owner-scoped conversationID; first upload may create namespace>
upload.body: raw binary; Content-Type allowlisted MIME; Content-Length required
upload.auth: existing session+CSRF; host account-generation and authorized conversation; no principal from client
upload.response: canonical part below, metadata issued by server only

scope: resolve owner+account generation+conversation before opening blob, quota or decrypt; wrong scope returns generic not-found and zero blob reads
media_scope: client_capabilities(host_scope)['media_scope'] = first32hex SHA256(canonical JSON [domain, authenticated owner, account generation]); opaque nonPII storage partition only, never bearer/auth credential. Host exposes in bootstrap/capabilities. Client IndexedDB partition and draft keys MUST include media_scope and conversationID, switch account resets visible drafts and selects new partition. Never infer server authorization from this token.
retention: Permanent until explicit authenticated conversation/account deletion, expires_at=null. Quota/rate/disk admission explicit, no silent removal or truncation. Deletion hooks remove blobs and retain technical tombstones without touching unrelated history; failure must be visible to deletion caller.
wire: Keep refs in history/ACOM/JEV; authenticate metadata before projection; count text and modality separately; admit budget/wallet on compact refs with modality estimate; expand to official inline data URI only for MiMo after final projection and immediately before single HTTP POST. Never public URLs.
client_requirements: Upload binary then use returned canonical reference. IndexedDB can keep local blobs/refs; never place raw data URI in localStorage or request history. Show upload/refusal/deletion state and no promise of unlimited duration/context. Do not silently truncate or remove old conversations.
server_requirements: Use per-request Flask max_content_length=37499904 BEFORE body parsing only for upload route, leaving app MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH unchanged; older Flask without per-request override must refuse until explicit compatible route guard is installed. Configure early HTTP guard so global 32MiB before_request cannot reject this authenticated upload before route guard. Preserve auth+CSRF/rate limits/wallet and MiMo2/Auto3 without autogrant. Scope/authorization callbacks are local host identity/conversation checks, never Bancada/network calls. Workers/nonMiMo reject iald_media before credentials/request. Resolution authorization uses the authenticated account generation from ACOM.
http_glue_owner: PARENT/Averroes owns actual _RequisicaoIALD read-only property branch and early guards; adapter only verifies current max_content_length, never writes a read-only property or global Flask limit.
upload_recovery: 300-second technical lease with process PID+birth, not a media duration cap. Only unpublished interrupted/expired intents may be reconciled. Active files retained until explicit deletion. Publication/revocation serialized under DB lock.
